credential.requirements: Per secondary sources: a current RN/APRN licence plus a master's or higher from an accredited adult-gerontology acute care NP programme, then the certifier's exam. One Wikipedia-derived summary mentions at least 500 clinical hours. I did not see the ANCC eligibility page itself.
